title: Decision Models as Policy Gates for Coding Agents: Explicit Policy Boundaries Improve Detection and Reduce False Alarms
abstract: arXiv:2611.02155v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents can destroy data, leak secrets and message the wrong person faster than a human can review. Could a decision model catch these risks at runtime? We evaluated 22 hosted decision models and two prompted general models as classifiers for a multi-rule policy engine. A synthetic dataset of 2,643 tool calls was labeled blind against 28 rules, with a sealed holdout. With a single shared preamble in both conditions, explicit boundaries written as examples and counterexamples raised recall by 5.5-26.1 percentage points on all 23 available models and reduced false positives on 21. Jev 1.14's recall rose from 89.3% to 98.2%, while unnecessary interruptions fell from 30.6% to 4.8% of 252 clean actions. With examples, its median latency was 120 ms at $0.46 per thousand requests. translated_title: 决策模型作为编码代理的策略门控：显式策略边界提升检测能力并减少误报
translated_abstract: 编码代理破坏数据、泄露机密以及向错误对象发送消息的速度可能比人类审查的速度还快。决策模型能否在运行时捕获这些风险？我们评估了22个托管决策模型和两个通过提示词驱动的通用模型，将其作为多规则策略引擎的分类器。一个包含2,643次工具调用的合成数据集针对28条规则进行了盲标注，并保留了密封的留存测试集。在两种条件下使用单一共享前导文本的情况下，以示例和反例形式编写的显式边界使所有23个可用模型的召回率提高了5.5至26.1个百分点，并在21个模型上降低了误报。Jev 1.14的召回率从89.3%提升至98.2%，同时针对252个正常操作的不必要干预比例从30.6%降至4.8%。使用示例时，其中位延迟为120毫秒，成本为每千次请求0.46美元。强模型在具体名称被替换为通用描述后仍保留了召回率收益；当相同边界以……形式编写时，三个模型也基本保留了这些收益。
tldr: 以示例和反例形式编写的显式策略边界能显著提升决策模型作为编码代理运行时策略门控的风险检测召回率（提升5.5-26.1个百分点），同时大幅降低误报率。
en_tdlr: Explicit policy boundaries written as examples and counterexamples significantly improve recall (by 5.5-26.1 percentage points) and reduce false alarms when decision models serve as runtime policy gates for coding agents.
